title: The Hypocrisy Gap: Quantifying Divergence Between Internal Belief and Chain-of-Thought Explanation via Sparse Autoencoders

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the divergence between a model's internal truth belief (measured via sparse linear probes on Sparse Autoencoder latents) and its chain-of-thought explanations when subjected to user pressure prompts, evaluated using Anthropic's Sycophancy benchmark.
